description: Queue-number look-back watcher for Rokid glasses: the wearer reads the hall screen once with their own eyes (your number + the number now called, stepped in or dictated), then rests their eyes while the agent prompts a look-back on a cadence, tracks gap/pace/rough ETA from the wearer's own updates, speaks up when 3 numbers remain, calls out when the number hits, and says plainly when it has already passed. Numbers come from the wearer, never from screen reading and never from listening to the PA system; reminders fire only while this page is open and nothing is stored.
name: signal-watch
